context.title: Use SHA-256 for cache key hashing

pr.description: Cache keys longer than 250 characters are hashed. We used CRC32, which produced collisions in staging with ~2M keys; SHA-256 removes them. Overhead is ~0.3 µs per key.

pr.description: Moves `app/auth/*.py` to `packages/auth/` so it can be versioned independently. Only import paths change.

New projects generated from the template ship with `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = False`, so session cookies are sent over plain HTTP unless people remember to change it. This flips the default and documents how to disable it for local development.
general_discussion: user-kenji: This will break local dev over http for some people.
author-elena: Yes, that's why the docs section shows the override for DEBUG mode.

comments: rev-dani: The new copy says "No account found with that email". The old page always showed the same message on purpose, otherwise this becomes an account enumeration endpoint.
author-lu: Reverted to the generic message: "If an account exists, you'll receive an email".

context.title: Move document permission checks into a mixin

pr.description: Pure refactor: the four document views had copy-pasted permission code, now they share `DocumentPermissionMixin`. No behaviour change intended.

comments: rev-ines: The old `DocumentEditView` also checked `doc.owner == request.user`. The mixin only checks `is_authenticated`, so after this change any logged-in user can edit any document.
author-caio: Wow, good catch. Added the owner check back to the mixin and a test for it.

context.title: Make file uploads retry on flaky networks

pr.description: Uploads now retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff so large files complete securely even on unstable mobile connections.

context.title: Fix SQL injection in product search endpoint

pr.description: The `q` parameter of `/api/products/search` was concatenated directly into a raw SQL string, which allowed SQL injection. This PR switches to parameterized queries and adds a regression test with a `' OR 1=1 --` payload.
general_discussion: maintainer-ana: Thanks! Can we get this into the next patch release?
author-joao: Sure, I'll open the backport PR.

context.title: Show a friendly message when the session expires

pr.description: When an API call returns 401 the app now shows a toast "Your session expired, please sign in again" and redirects to the login page, instead of a blank screen.

context.title: Remove hardcoded AWS credentials from settings

pr.description: `settings/base.py` contained a hardcoded AWS access key and secret that were committed in 2023. They have been rotated; this PR loads them from environment variables instead.
